summary: ADV-8 and ADV-11 are closed. The shared loader keeps the 15 validation predicates and two discovery cases, flags the tested non-.md post forms, ignores JSON companions, and loads shipped Markdown posts. The full phase diff contains no production or post changes.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD returned 704745a3ca2bb27b52f28e2fcf65df9d994b64ac, matching role_base_sha and audited_head_sha.

ADV-8 and ADV-11 are withdrawn: fixtures/blog-posts-loader.ts:33–38 flags Markdown-like extensions and case-insensitive .md suffixes that are not exactly .md; lines 45–61 lists non-hidden files in locale folders; lines 68–85 parses only lowercase .md files.

The validation test preserves all 15 rules and both discovery cases. Comparison with 257a6b0cd^ shows the per-post checks became aggregate checks over every loaded post; required-field, optional-field, content, naming, and locale-date predicates remain equivalent. The .md rule now checks the shared discovery predicate.

blog-posts-validation.test.ts:56–60 and 211–216 keep discovery non-vacuous and require no mislabelled post files. The adversarial tests at lines 37–72 exercise .mdx discovery and uppercase .MD rejection.

The shipped locale folders contain .md posts and -segments.json companions. The loader parses only .md; the suffix predicate excludes .json, so companions do not become posts or hide their corresponding Markdown files.
The targeted Vitest run passed 2 files and 19 tests: blog-posts-validation.test.ts and blog-posts-loader.adversarial.test.ts.

proof-adv8.log shows a malformed .mdx probe fails three validation assertions and names the path. proof-adv11.log shows an uppercase .MD probe fails the extension and both discovery assertions and names the path. Both probes were removed.
The adversarial-704745a.json receipt reports pass at the audited head, confirms the .MD probe and 17 validation tests, and records ADV-12 through ADV-14 as notes rather than findings.
The exact phase diff 8a126f612abcc258c6c6711d6ac03fa085bbcbff..704745a3ca2bb27b52f28e2fcf65df9d994b64ac contains test files, test fixtures, and plan.md only. The blog posts path has no changed files.
gate-88b26fb9b.json reports GREEN, COVERAGE, check-types, and lint exit 0; it records 1398 cases and 91.95% line coverage, above the 85.52% floor.
The plan records baseline=3175 and current cases=1398. The reduction is 55.97%; the maximum count allowed by a 20% reduction is 2540.
